name: open_pane
description: Split the window: open a new pane next to the current one. Use for split, new pane, open X in a pane

side.description: which side of the current pane

program.description: program to start in it, only if the user names one

name.description: what to call the pane, only if the user names it

name: open_tab
description: Open a new tab. Use for new tab, open X in a tab

program.description: program to start in it, only if the user names one

name.description: what to call the tab, only if the user names it

name: close_pane
description: Close, kill or quit a pane. Only when the user says close, kill, quit or exit

pane.description: current, left, right, above, below, or the name or program of a pane

name: close_tab
description: Close, kill or quit a tab. Only when the user says close, kill, quit or exit

tab.description: current, a tab number, or the name or program of a tab

name: go_to_pane
description: Go to, switch to, move to or focus another pane without changing it

pane.description: left, right, above, below, or the name or program of a pane

name: go_to_tab
description: Go to or switch to another tab without changing it

tab.description: next, previous, a tab number, or the name or program of a tab

name: arrange_panes
description: Rearrange the panes in this tab

layout.description: grid; stack shows one pane at a time; vertical is side by side; horizontal is one above another

name: rename_tab
description: Rename or call the current tab something

name: resize_pane
description: Make the current pane wider, narrower, taller or shorter

amount.description: number of cells, only if the user gives one

name: run_in_pane
description: Type a command into an existing pane and press enter. Use for run X in a pane, type X

pane.description: current, left, right, above, below, or the name or program of a pane

name: maximize_pane
description: Show one pane full-size (zoom or maximize it), or restore the previous layout

pane.description: current, left, right, above, below, or the name or program of a pane

restore.description: true to un-maximize and restore the layout

pane.description: current, left, right, above, below, or the name or program of a pane

name: swap_panes
description: Swap the current pane with its neighbour on one side

name: move_tab
description: Move the current tab left or right in the tab bar, or to a position

position.description: tab position, only if the user gives one
